review:
A very swingy rodeo on a 5x5 grid, made with Strmlytics, the team behind Aztec Clusters and Snoop Dogg Dollars. It's all about risky mechanics and interactive features.

Two free spins modes – Free Spins and Super Free Spins – and surprise wilds that can land at any time. Chance x3 makes either bonus more likely. 10,000x max and an outstanding 97.35% RTP, but free spins are rare, about once every 332 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.35% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 332 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
